calculation.description: Reverse the lagged three-trading-day return and scale it by the contemporaneous volume surprise versus the trailing 20-day median; cross-sectionally median-centered for portfolio ranking. All inputs are lagged/observable at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2020, 2023-24, 2025-26, and online 2026-07-01 through 2027-02-25; online IC 0.021287 and ICIR 0.066052 is below the ICIR gate in the short recent subsample, so monitor drift. The full history passes the benchmark gates. Cross-section is the 15-asset benchmark and dates require at least 8 valid instruments.
